summary: The technologies used by this website and your choices.
markdown:
> REVIEW COPY: Not published. Check production network and infrastructure settings before release and set the actual effective date.

# Cookie Policy

Effective date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]

This policy concerns cookies, browser storage, pixels and similar technologies on https://exactmec.com, operated by 台州巽风贸易有限公司 under the ExactMec brand. See our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for inquiry records and contact choices.

## 1. The current website

Fonts and website images are served with the website. The application does not keep persistent form drafts. Optional Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, ShipSolo-hosted Plausible and Ahrefs Web Analytics measurement starts on public marketing pages only after you choose Allow. These services can process technical data including IP address, device and network information. Google and Microsoft may use cookies and related identifiers. Inquiry forms, confirmation pages, legal pages, customer accounts and restricted administration are excluded from this third-party measurement.

| Technology or function | Current use | Duration or control |
|---|---|---|
| Inquiry fields and duplicate-submission protection | Held in the page's working memory while you complete or submit the form. A submission identifier helps avoid duplicate saves. The application does not save a persistent browser copy of your form. | Cleared when the page is closed or reloaded, or the form is reset. A successfully submitted record is handled under the Privacy Policy. |
| Inquiry source snapshot | The first available page, submission page, referring website origin and permitted campaign labels stay in page memory, then accompany a submitted inquiry. Raw query strings, referral paths and ad click identifiers are excluded. | No browser identifier or source-history storage is created. The saved inquiry is covered by the Privacy Policy. |
| Optional first-party measurement | With your choice, our own endpoint counts known page and button events in daily totals. It does not store visitor IDs or inquiry details, and does not count unique people. | Off before your choice. Use Measurement choices to allow, decline or withdraw. Declining does not affect inquiries. |
| Google Analytics 4 | Optional page views and quotation/WhatsApp button clicks on marketing pages. The application supplies the canonical page path without query parameters, a blank referrer, and no inquiry fields. The _ga and _ga_E8EBN552MZ cookies can distinguish browsers. Google signals and advertising personalization are disabled in our integration. | Loaded only after allowance. Cookie lifetime and service retention depend on Google and property settings. Withdraw using Measurement choices; the website clears its accessible analytics cookies and reloads to unload the tags. |
| Microsoft Clarity | Optional marketing-page session recordings and heatmaps. Website content is masked before the tag loads. Clarity is skipped if the current URL contains a query/fragment or the referring address is outside our restricted safe pattern. _clck and _clsk cookies, and Microsoft identifiers such as MUID or SM, may be used by the service. Masking does not hide all technical/device information from Microsoft. | Loaded only after allowance. Duration and provider-side retention depend on Microsoft settings. Withdrawal stops the integration and unloads it; browser controls are needed to manage cookies on other domains. |
| ShipSolo-hosted Plausible | Optional page views and quotation/WhatsApp button clicks sent to plausible.shipsolo.io/api/event. We use the event interface instead of its automatic script so raw URLs and referral addresses are excluded. No Plausible browser identifier or cookie is created by this website adapter. The host still receives technical request information. | Starts only after allowance. No browser event backlog is kept or replayed. Provider-side handling and retention are separate from browser storage. |
| Ahrefs Web Analytics | Optional marketing page views, quotation/WhatsApp button events and SDK-observed public link clicks. Receives public page titles, canonical URLs, checked referrers and technical data. The provider describes cookieless measurement with a daily pseudonymous visitor ID. | No Ahrefs browser cookie is set by this integration. Requires a fresh optional choice; query/fragment URLs and unsafe referrers skip the tag. Withdrawal unloads the tag, rather than deleting provider-side records. |
| Measurement preference | Browser local storage key exactmec_measurement_choice_v3 stores only allow or deny. An earlier first-party-only or v2 three-provider allowance is not reused for the additional Ahrefs service. It is not a visitor identifier or form draft. | Until you change the choice or clear storage. If storage is blocked, a choice applies to that document; we do not treat a non-writable old allowance as fresh permission. |
| Optional customer sign in | When My Inquiries is enabled and you verify your email address, the necessary first-party __Host-exactmec_customer cookie identifies that limited session so you can access only your own submitted inquiries. It is not used for analytics or advertising and cannot be read by website JavaScript. | Up to 8 hours; signing out invalidates it. No account or customer sign-in cookie is needed to submit a mold inquiry. Verification challenges and CSRF values stay in page memory. |
| Cloudflare infrastructure | Delivers and protects requests and may process network or security information. This is separate from the application's form state. | Any additional security technology must be checked against the actual deployed configuration. We do not describe the whole infrastructure as universally cookie-free. |
| Restricted administration | Staff authentication technology applies to the restricted administration area. A prospective customer does not need an administrator account to request a quotation. | Determined by the staff access configuration, separately from the public inquiry form. |

## 2. Choices and browser settings

Measurement choices appears near the footer when this feature is enabled, including on the review website. Optional tags and events remain off until you affirmatively allow them. You can reject them or reopen the choices to withdraw. Withdrawal reloads the page to remove active third-party listeners. A refusal does not prevent an ordinary mold inquiry, and earlier events are not replayed after a later allowance. Optional first-party daily totals remain a separate release setting. No Google Ads or Meta advertising pixel is included in this integration.

For provider information, see [Google's partner-site explanation](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites), [Microsoft's privacy statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement), [Plausible's event interface documentation](https://plausible.io/docs/events-api), and [Ahrefs' measurement explanation](https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/10247870-about-ahrefs-web-analytics). The Plausible software here is hosted at ShipSolo's endpoint; the software documentation does not establish the host's own retention or contractual terms.

You can use your browser's controls to remove or restrict cookies and site storage. Closing or reloading an unsubmitted inquiry page can discard its in-memory information. Information already submitted is handled through the record-request process in the Privacy Policy.

## 3. External services

The WhatsApp button is an ordinary external link. It does not load an embedded WhatsApp chat or advertising SDK. WhatsApp applies its own technologies and policies when you choose to open that service.

Other external links also lead to separately operated services. Their browser settings and policies are separate from whether an inquiry was saved on our website. Later additions of embedded media, chat, CAPTCHA or tracking must be reflected in the actual website inventory before activation.

## 4. Contact and updates

Contact sales@exactmec.com with questions. We update this policy when technologies change. The effective date identifies the version actually released, not the date an internal draft was prepared.

title: Privacy Policy
summary: How we handle mold inquiries, contact choices and project information.
markdown:
> REVIEW COPY: Not published. Updated for an inquiry-only website and the operator's instruction to disable AI assistance for the public mailbox. Set the effective date when the reviewed version is released.

# Privacy Policy

Effective date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]

## 1. Who handles your information

ExactMec is operated by **台州巽风贸易有限公司**, a company registered in mainland China. In this policy, “we” and “us” mean that company as the operator responsible for the inquiry information described here.

Contact address: No. 46 Jinqing Avenue, Luqiao, Taizhou, Zhejiang, China (中国浙江台州路桥金清大道46号)  
Privacy contact: sales@exactmec.com  
Business contact: sales@exactmec.com  
Website: https://exactmec.com

This website collects mold inquiries and provides a link to WhatsApp for further discussion. It does not accept online orders or payments. Our restricted dashboard is used to review submitted inquiries and keep relevant follow-up notes. Any later project agreement is arranged separately.

Submitting an inquiry does not require registration or sign in. When the optional My Inquiries service is available, you may verify the same email address to view your submitted inquiries, add project notes and request withdrawal of an inquiry.

## 2. Information we receive

When you submit a mold inquiry, we receive your name, company or professional identity, email, contact number, country and city, together with the component name, project description, mold quantity and whether you have drawings or a physical sample.

You may also provide a company website, application, material requirements, planned purchasing time, and an approximate per-mold budget and currency. These additional items are optional. A company name, location or stated budget is not treated as proof of identity or purchasing capacity.

We record an inquiry reference, submission time, follow-up status, your contact choices and their versions, and relevant review notes. With a submitted inquiry, we also save the first available and submission page, a referring website origin, and available campaign labels (UTM parameters). Page query strings, referral paths and advertising click identifiers are excluded; unknown sources remain blank. The source snapshot is held in page memory before submission, without a visitor identifier or persistent browser history. We use it to understand where this particular inquiry came from. Our website and infrastructure may also process technical information needed for delivery, security and error handling, as described below.

The inquiry form does not require an online drawing upload. If we later receive drawings, sample information or messages through an agreed communication channel, we use them for the project discussion and assessment. Please do not include identification documents, payment credentials or unrelated sensitive information in an inquiry.

For optional customer sign in, we process the email address you enter, a short-lived email verification challenge and a limited session record. The website database stores verification hashes rather than the email code or a password. Project notes and withdrawal requests you add through My Inquiries are attached to the relevant inquiry. Verifying an email address does not verify a company or purchasing capacity.

## 3. Why we use it

We use relevant information to assess whether a project matches our custom die casting mold services, identify missing quotation information, respond to your request, coordinate necessary technical assessment, and follow up about that inquiry. We also use limited operational information to protect the service, avoid duplicate submissions and manage access.

Customer verification and the necessary sign-in cookie are used to restrict My Inquiries to records associated with the verified email address. Customers cannot view our internal review notes or other customers' records. Choosing not to use this service does not prevent you from submitting an inquiry or contacting us.

We may review relevant public business information to check consistency with a project. We do not treat automated format checks or a complete form as verification of a company, and we do not make a final purchasing qualification solely from a budget, city or email domain.

Inquiry handling is separate from unrelated marketing. Submitting the form does not sign you up for a newsletter or authorize a general promotional campaign.

## 4. Your choices and the basis for processing

For the inquiry processing described on the form, we request the purpose-limited permission stated there. You can withdraw that permission by contacting us. We explain the effect on a pending inquiry and stop processing that depends on the withdrawn permission, subject to any applicable requirement or other independently applicable basis to retain limited records.

The necessary fields are identified on the form. Optional project information can be left blank. The form's limited-purpose permission does not authorize unrelated marketing, calls or optional tracking. If a later activity requires a separate notice, choice or other legal basis, we address it before that activity. An inquiry choice is not a substitute for a separately required permission.

## 5. How we contact you

After a successful submission, we can follow up by email about your inquiry even if you do not continue to WhatsApp. If you choose the optional WhatsApp message permission, we may also message that number about this inquiry and its progress. You can submit without choosing WhatsApp and ask us to stop using a channel at any time.

Permission for project messages is not permission for unrelated marketing or WhatsApp calls. If you start a conversation yourself, we may respond to that request. Clicking a WhatsApp button alone does not tell us that you have sent a message.

WhatsApp is a separate service with its own [privacy policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy). Information you send in a conversation is handled through that service and by the people authorized to handle your project.

## 6. Who receives information and where it is processed

Access is limited to people authorized to handle inquiries and relevant service providers. We share only information needed for the applicable purpose, rather than automatically sending a full contact record to every manufacturing partner.

| Service or recipient | Purpose and information involved |
|---|---|
| Cloudflare website hosting and security | Serves the website and protects requests. Network information such as IP addresses and request metadata may be processed to deliver and secure the service. |
| Cloudflare D1 inquiry database | Stores submitted inquiry information, contact choices, review records and operational status for authorized business handling. |
| Cloudflare Email Service and our hosted mailbox | Delivers minimal internal inquiry reminders and handles messages you send to sales@exactmec.com. The mailbox uses Cloudflare storage for messages and attachments. A reminder contains an inquiry reference and restricted dashboard link, not the customer's full form. |
| Customer verification email, when enabled | Sends a one-time sign-in code to the email address associated with submitted inquiries. This is a requested account-access message, not a marketing subscription. The customer sign-in transport is configured separately from internal reminders. |
| WhatsApp | An external contact link opens WhatsApp only when you choose it. This website does not embed a WhatsApp chat SDK or read your WhatsApp conversations. |
| Manufacturing partners | Receive only project information needed for a particular assessment or agreed project. We arrange file sharing after contact; a form submission does not automatically distribute the full lead to a supplier. |
| Optional first-party website measurement | When enabled and allowed through Measurement choices, our own Cloudflare endpoint counts daily totals for known website pages and button actions. These totals contain no visitor identifier, inquiry reference, contact or project details, raw URL query, referrer, user-agent or IP address. This remains separate from inquiry source snapshots and the third-party services below. |
| Google Analytics 4 | With separate optional tracking permission, measures marketing-page views and quotation/WhatsApp button clicks. Our integration supplies canonical page paths without query strings, a blank referrer and no contact or project fields. Google can process browser identifiers, cookies and technical request information. Google signals and advertising personalization are disabled in this integration. |
| Microsoft Clarity | With the same optional permission, provides marketing-page session recordings and heatmaps. Content is masked before loading; unsafe current URLs or referring addresses prevent loading. Microsoft still receives technical/session information and may use cookies and identifiers. Forms, confirmation pages, legal pages, customer accounts and administration are excluded. |
| ShipSolo-hosted Plausible | With optional permission, receives limited marketing-page and quotation/WhatsApp click events through plausible.shipsolo.io/api/event. We exclude raw queries, referral addresses, contact and project fields. Our adapter creates no Plausible browser cookie or visitor ID; the host can still process IP, user-agent and other technical request information. This is a separately hosted service, not a claim that Plausible's software publisher operates the endpoint. |
| Ahrefs Web Analytics | With fresh optional permission, receives public marketing-page views, quotation/WhatsApp events and SDK-observed public link clicks. It processes public page titles, canonical addresses, checked referrers and technical/device information. The provider describes cookieless measurement and a daily pseudonymous visitor ID derived using IP and user-agent information. Our integration skips parameterized URLs and unsafe referrers and excludes inquiry forms and private areas. |

Our operator handles inquiries from mainland China. Cloudflare runs a global infrastructure, so network processing, storage and authorized access may occur outside your country. We do not promise that all data stays in a visitor's country or in one particular region. Cloudflare describes its service handling in its [privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) and [customer data processing terms](https://www.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-customer-dpa/).

Optional tracking permission is independent of inquiry permission and is initially off. You can reject it or withdraw through Measurement choices without losing access to an ordinary inquiry. Withdrawal stops future tracking in this browser; it does not itself erase information already received by a provider. The services above may process information outside your country. See [Google's explanation](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites), [Microsoft's privacy statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement), [Ahrefs' explanation](https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/10247870-about-ahrefs-web-analytics), and our Cookie Policy for technologies and controls. Contact us about information already collected. A WhatsApp button click is not proof that a message was sent, and this marketing integration does not transmit a completed inquiry or its contents to these services.

Before a project-specific disclosure or transfer requiring further safeguards, notice or permission, we address those requirements for that activity. You may contact us for details of the relevant arrangement. We do not treat the website's inquiry checkbox as approval for every possible future disclosure.

AI assistance is disabled for sales@exactmec.com, including automatic reply drafts and AI rewriting or verification of manually written messages. The website inquiry form does not call an AI service. Inquiry review and customer correspondence are handled by people. Discuss special handling with us before sending confidential project files.

## 7. How long information is kept

We keep identifiable inquiry records only while needed to review the request, communicate with you, keep relevant follow-up history and protect the service. A form submission is an inquiry record, not an online order record. The website does not apply an automatic expiry based on whether a sale occurred.

We review whether records are still needed for these purposes and delete or anonymize information when it is no longer needed. You can ask us to delete your inquiry or stop contacting you by emailing sales@exactmec.com. Limited preservation may apply where a specific legal obligation or dispute requires it; in that case, use is restricted to that purpose. We do not keep unrelated contact details merely because a record was once submitted.

Clearly invalid or spam submissions are removed when they are no longer needed for necessary security investigation or error handling. Internal reminder emails contain only an inquiry reference and restricted dashboard link. We review these copies separately rather than treating an email copy as a reason to keep the entire inquiry. Our application uses short-lived pseudonymous rate-limit records instead of storing raw IP addresses in the lead database; infrastructure security records follow the provider's applicable service handling.

Customer sign-in challenges expire after 10 minutes and sessions after 8 hours. Expired challenge, session and abuse-limit records are removed during service housekeeping. Signing out invalidates the current session. Supplemental project notes follow the inquiry's retention rules. Withdrawing an inquiry records a request to stop that project's follow-up; it does not automatically delete the inquiry, email or WhatsApp history. Use the contact below for deletion or a broader contact-stop request.

Cloudflare D1 recovery copies can include earlier database states within its rolling recovery window, up to 30 days under the service limits. Deletion from the active database does not instantly erase every recovery copy. Deleted information is not used for ordinary business contact from recovery copies. Before reopening a restored database, deletion and contact-stop decisions must be reapplied. Relevant email and separately shared project records also need to be addressed when handling a deletion request.

Contact-stop records are limited to information needed to honor the choice and avoid contacting you again. We do not retain a full project merely to remember a stop request. Information exchanged later in WhatsApp is handled through that service and the applicable project discussion; an inquiry form submission does not automatically copy that conversation into the website dashboard.

## 8. Protection and requests

We use access controls and safeguards appropriate to the information and actual systems. No website or messaging channel can promise absolute security.

You can contact sales@exactmec.com to request information about your record, correction, deletion, withdrawal of permission, a change of contact channel or to raise a concern. We may ask for proportionate information to locate the record and verify the request. We do not routinely require identity documents for an ordinary inquiry request.

We handle requests, applicable exceptions and response periods under the law that applies. Depending on the applicable rules, your rights may also include objection, restriction, a copy or transfer of relevant information, or a complaint to a competent authority. We explain any applicable requirements or justified limits when handling a request.

## 9. Cookies and changes

See our [Cookie Policy](/cookies) for the actual technologies, purposes and choices. We update this notice when our handling changes and provide further notice or choices where required. A change to this notice does not retrospectively authorize a new use of existing information.

title: Project Information and Confidentiality
summary: What to prepare and how a custom mold project normally proceeds.
markdown:
> REVIEW COPY: Not published. This page describes the general inquiry workflow and does not replace a project agreement.

# Project Information and Confidentiality

Effective date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]

ExactMec is a website operated by 台州巽风贸易有限公司 for custom aluminum die casting mold inquiries.

## What to prepare

Please describe the component for which you need a mold, its intended use, the number of mold sets and whether you have clear 2D or 3D part drawings or a physical sample. One mold set is accepted for consideration.

You can submit basic contact and project information first. A formal quotation needs drawings or a physical sample sufficient for assessment. The form's drawing or sample status describes what you currently have; it does not mean that we have already received or approved it. Arrange file delivery or physical sample shipment with us after contact.

## How a project normally proceeds

1. We discuss your information and prepare a quotation based on assessable drawings or a sample.
2. Payment and project arrangements are agreed directly.
3. After payment, a 3D mold design is prepared for your confirmation.
4. Mold manufacturing begins after your design confirmation.
5. The completed mold is trialed and trial samples are sent to you for testing.
6. After you confirm that the samples are acceptable, the mold is shipped.

The indicative period is approximately 30–40 days from payment. The specific schedule, changes, confirmation time, sample delivery, customer testing and mold logistics must be clarified for the project. This is not a guaranteed worldwide arrival date. Trial samples are for mold validation; we do not currently offer ongoing die casting mass production.

## Handling your information

Project information is used for inquiry assessment, necessary manufacturing coordination and the agreed project. Access and disclosures should be limited to what the particular task requires. We do not automatically publish your drawings or use them as advertising material.

Materials should only be shared if you are entitled to provide them. If special handling is needed, discuss it before sending confidential files or samples. No method of communication provides an absolute security guarantee.

Submitting an inquiry does not transfer ownership of your product design. Ownership and use of the mold, changes, payment, transport and remedies must be addressed in the project arrangements.

For information requests or project coordination, contact sales@exactmec.com. For personal information matters, contact sales@exactmec.com or see our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

markdown:
> REVIEW COPY: Not published. Review the website terms and set the effective date at release. These are not the terms of a particular mold sale.

# Website Terms of Use

Effective date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]

## 1. Operator and purpose

This website is operated under the ExactMec brand by **台州巽风贸易有限公司**, registered in mainland China.

Website: https://exactmec.com  
Contact address: No. 46 Jinqing Avenue, Luqiao, Taizhou, Zhejiang, China (中国浙江台州路桥金清大道46号)  
Contact email: sales@exactmec.com

The website provides information about custom aluminum die casting molds and allows prospective customers to request a project discussion or quotation. It is intended for people acting for business or professional purposes. The customer's company field identifies the prospective buyer; it is separate from the identity of this website's operator.

## 2. Inquiries and quotations

Submitting a form creates an inquiry for review. It does not automatically create a mold order, establish a final price or verify a buyer's identity.

A formal mold quotation requires clear 2D or 3D part drawings, or a physical sample sufficient for assessment. Photos, general dimensions or a concept can support an initial discussion but are not automatically sufficient for quotation. Please only provide information and materials that you are entitled to share.

One mold set can be considered. Our current offer is for molds; trial samples are for validation and do not mean that we offer ongoing die casting parts production or independent CNC parts services.

We may contact you about the inquiry using the details and communication choices you provide, as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy). A successful submission remains recorded even if you do not send a WhatsApp message.

## 3. Project arrangements

Pricing, payment methods and stages, design changes, trial scope, shipping, cancellation and any applicable remedies are addressed in the written arrangements for the particular project, subject to applicable law. This website does not take online payments.

The actual contracting, payment-receiving and delivery parties must be identified in the quotation or project arrangements. A website brand or inquiry confirmation is not a substitute for that information.

Our general workflow is payment, preparation of a 3D mold design, customer design confirmation, mold manufacture, trial samples, customer testing and approval, and mold shipment. The indicative period is approximately 30–40 days counted from payment. The agreed project schedule must clarify its scope and the effect of confirmations, changes, sample transport, testing and final logistics. This is not a promise that a customer will receive a mold within 40 days in every location.

The [Project Information](/project-information) page explains the general process. Specific order terms must be agreed separately; mandatory rights or obligations are not excluded by these website terms.

## 4. Images, technical information and materials

Application illustrations explain possible uses of molds. They do not establish that every illustrated part has been manufactured or delivered by ExactMec. Real manufacturing and project images must be understood with their stated source and context.

General website information does not replace assessment of a particular design, material, machine interface or requirement. Capability figures, where provided, must be read with their conditions and the confirmed project scope.

Website content may be owned by us or used with permission. Do not reuse content in a way that infringes rights or falsely implies an affiliation. Sending project information for assessment does not by itself transfer ownership of your product design to us or grant us a public marketing license. Mold ownership and use rights belong in the project agreement.

## 5. Proper use and external services

Do not submit unlawful material, impersonate another person or company, send spam, interfere with the service, or attempt to access other customers' information or the administration system.

External communication links, including WhatsApp, lead to services with their own terms and privacy practices. A link does not mean we control that platform or automatically receive your messages.

## 6. Updates and contact

We may update these website terms to reflect actual changes. Website updates do not unilaterally change an already agreed mold order. Nothing here excludes a liability or right that cannot lawfully be excluded.

For questions, contact sales@exactmec.com. The applicable order terms, including any agreed dispute arrangements, must be addressed separately for the actual transaction. These website terms do not determine a dispute forum for every possible future order.
